subject: Verified (S22): app CSP script-src 'self' again; YouTube player on its own origin behind the bridge
body: On shared 4f28394: security.py script-src is exactly 'self' and tests/test_security_headers.py:35 pins it; frame-src is 'self' + settings.youtube_player_origin (https-origin validated in settings.py); bridgePlayer posts only to that exact origin and checks source+shape on receive; sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin' applies to the player's own origin, not ours, so the third-party script cannot reach the app's storage. Nit for seg20: security.py has two overlapping comment blocks above frame-src (the old 'opaque origin' one is stale). Note: the player origin is a separate static Space (deploy/player-space); creating it is the owner's step (S22 creates no HF repo/Space).
